project.name: OWASP Dependency-Track
project.description: An intelligent Component Analysis platform that allows organizations to identify and reduce risk in the software supply chain

reusability_assessment.notes: Permissive license that allows for reuse in both open-source and commercial projects. Must include license and copyright notices. Patent grant includes termination clause for patent litigation.

architecture.framework_description: Thin Server Architecture framework providing REST API scaffolding, security-first design, and asynchronous event processing

deployment_models.name: API Server
deployment_models.description: Server-side functionality only, requires separate frontend deployment

deployment_models.name: Frontend
deployment_models.description: Independent deployment capable, communicates via REST API

deployment_models.name: Bundled
deployment_models.description: API Server + Frontend combined in single deployment

design_patterns.implementation: 36 event types for asynchronous processing of vulnerability analysis, policy evaluation, data synchronization, and metrics updates
Abstract base classes for extensible vulnerability analyzers and policy evaluators
Multiple parser implementations for different SBOM formats and vulnerability sources
Specialized query managers for domain-specific data access
Dynamic instantiation of parsers, publishers, and evaluators based on configuration
Policy conditions evaluated in combination with ALL/ANY operators
Notification system with rule-based routing to multiple publishers

sbom_management.description: Comprehensive SBOM processing with support for multiple formats and versions

validation: Secure parsing with external entities disabled
extracted_data: Component metadata (name, version, group, description, publisher)
Multiple hash algorithms (MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, SHA3-256/384/512, BLAKE2b, BLAKE3)

processing_workflow: BOM upload reception via REST API

vulnerability_database_integration.description: Multi-source vulnerability intelligence aggregation with internal matching engine

sources.name: Sonatype OSS Index
sources.authentication: HTTP Basic Auth with encrypted credentials
sources.resilience: Exponential backoff retry with configurable parameters

internal_analysis.description: Internal vulnerability matching engine using component identifiers

version_normalization: Normalize for NVD and GHSA compatibility
matching_algorithm.range_analysis: Normalized version comparison against vulnerable version ranges

process_flow: Component capability assessment (requires CPE or PURL)
Extract vendor and product names from identifiers
Optional fuzzy matching for edge cases
Link vulnerabilities to components via junction table

vulnerability_correlation.description: Vulnerability aliasing and de-duplication across sources

risk_scoring_and_impact_assessment.description: Multi-dimensional risk assessment using weighted severity and CVSS scoring

inherited_risk_score.calculation: Sum of (vulnerability_count * severity_weight) across all vulnerabilities
inherited_risk_score.storage: Cached in DependencyMetrics table as lastInheritedRiskScore

severity_classification.usage: Ordinal comparison and consistent categorization across system

impact_analysis.description: Blast radius assessment through dependency relationships

findings_model.structure: Aggregation of Component + Vulnerability + Analysis + Attribution

policy_enforcement.description: Flexible policy engine with pluggable evaluators for security, license, and operational compliance

architecture.pattern: Pluggable evaluator pattern with composite condition evaluation

operator.ANY: Triggers if one or more conditions violated
operator.ALL: Triggers only if all conditions violated

evaluation_workflow: Retrieve applicable policies (global, project, tag-based, hierarchical)

violation_tracking.analysis: ViolationAnalysis - tracks human decisions and responses

component_analysis.description: Comprehensive component tracking with cryptographic verification and metadata enrichment

package_identifiers: PURL coordinates (type, namespace, name, version only)

internal_component_identification.purpose: Classify and tag internal vs. external components

dependency_graph.description: Dependency relationship modeling with latest version tracking
exposed_information: Latest available versions from repository metadata

security.validation: User access to parent project validated before disclosure

metadata_enrichment.purpose: Fetch latest version information from package repositories

project.description: Primary organizational unit for component tracking

component.description: Software dependencies, packages, libraries, and applications

bom.description: Software Bill of Materials import records

Separates reporting functions from core logic

responsibilities: Filter by project scope and tags

routing_workflow: Apply scope, group, and level filtering
Filter projects by constraints and tags

recommendations: Adapt policy engine for custom rules

integration_recommendations: Start with Docker Compose deployment for evaluation
Use API-first approach - deploy frontend separately
Integrate with CI/CD via BOM upload API
Configure external analyzers incrementally (OSS Index → Snyk → others)
Start with basic policies, expand as team gains experience
Leverage notification system for workflow automation
Use project hierarchy for organizational structure
Export findings to existing security platforms (DefectDojo, etc.)
customization_opportunities: Custom policy evaluators for domain-specific rules
Additional vulnerability sources via parser plugins
Custom notification publishers for internal systems
